mapper.select: SELECT FROM aftersale_case WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM aftersale_case WHERE order_id=#{order} AND active_flag=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE aftersale_case SET status='INVALIDATED',active_flag=0,invalidated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{case} AND order_id=#{order} AND store_id=#{store} AND version=#{oldVersion} AND active_flag=1 AND source_stage='UNVERIFIED_POST_START' AND status=#{oldStatus} AND invalidated_at IS NULL

UPDATE aftersale_case SET status='INVALIDATED',active_flag=0,invalidated_at=#{at},current_supplement_id=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{case} AND order_id=#{order} AND store_id=#{store} AND version=#{oldVersion} AND active_flag=1 AND workflow_revision=1 AND source_stage='UNVERIFIED_POST_START' AND status=#{oldStatus} AND invalidated_at IS NULL

UPDATE aftersale_supplement SET status='CANCELED',closed_at=#{at},completion_verification_id=#{verification} WHERE id=#{supplement} AND aftersale_id=#{case} AND status='OPEN' AND completion_command_id IS NULL AND completion_verification_id IS NULL
